content.short: CryptoHacker is a simulation game on TON where players 'hack' virtual vaults for token rewards.
content.description: CryptoHacker is an engaging simulation game built as a Telegram Mini App on the TON blockchain. It casts players in the role of a digital intruder, tasked with 'hacking' through various levels of virtual security to unlock vaults containing in-game tokens. These rewards can then be exchanged for real Jettons within the project's ecosystem. CryptoHacker focuses on progression-based gameplay and provides a fun, thematic way for users to participate in the decentralized economy, leveraging TON's fast and low-cost transaction capabilities for seamless reward distribution.
content.meta: Become a master hacker and earn rewards with CryptoHacker on TON. Play on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
